Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the statute authorizing use of banked levy capacity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the statute authorizing use of bankedlevy capacity; creating a new section; and repealing RCW 84.55.092.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that Washington statevoters have repeatedly expressed their will to limit taxing districts'property tax collections absent voter approval. In 2000, votersapproved Initiative Measure No. 722 which provided for the eliminationof taxing districts' banked capacity. The legislature recognizes thesupreme court invalidated the initiative, and finds it is in theinterest of the people of the state of Washington, and in conformancewith the expressed will of the voters, that the elimination of bankedcapacity be reenacted and reaffirmed.
RCW 84.55.092 (Protection of future levycapacity) and 1998 c 16 s 3, 1988 c 274 s 4, & 1986 c 107 s 3 are eachrepealed.
